description: Seven Days is a text mystery adventure game enjoyable for all audiences, with uniquely styled illustrations. The game proceeds as a series of chats, and users read through the story as they make important decisions. The choices made determine the route the story takes. Try the new 7 Days! Mystery Puzzle Interactive Novel Story now. Are you getting bored of the classic, monotonous games? Will you like to play a choice based game offering different outcomes based on the choices you make? The new interactive fiction text story app is here to help you eliminate boredom and figure out how your brain makes choices. You are the decision maker and you will need to make tough decisions to reach the best outcome in the game. ■ Summary Every choice you make changes your story. Small choices add up to transform your relationships with comrades and determine your destiny and those of your comrades at critical moments. You can choose to become the ultimate villain, or a trustworthy friend. Everything depends on what you decide. ■ Synopsis A number of dead spirits have been assigned to an interactive fiction test. Successfully completing the interactive story test ensures they will be resurrected. The messenger of death has assigned them each a task. They must attack one another or work together to solve mystery and complete their tasks. Your character, Kirell, must also complete the choice based games task she has been assigned. But her tasks requires her to be the decision maker for others die. Solve Mystery The interactive story choice based game requires you to be the decision maker and solve mystery. Join the text story and shoot your shot in one of the most intense interactive fiction storyline games. With every choice you make in this game, the outcome of storyline games will change. The most thrilling part about this interactive fiction text story game is that you will never be able to guess the exact outcome of the choices you make. Make Your Choice At every step of the interactive story, you will be required to make a choice. As a decision maker of the choice based games, you will move through a series of texts, expressions, scenarios and charts to understand what is going on and make your move wisely. Remember that even the slightest choices can lead to big changes so you must stay cautious. She has only seven days. What choices will you make? ■ Unique features of 7 Days! Mystery Puzzle Interactive Novel Story - Graphic Novel-style artwork with stunning graphics - Storyline that changes according to your choices - Various achievements and hidden challenges - Multiple endings based on different choices of decision maker - Interactive text story featuring expressions, charts and story options - Solve mystery in the storyline games and discover new endings - Mind-based, decision making game that requires lots of focus - Use your intellect to ace the interactive fiction choice based games The fun of the game is guaranteed.
